title: Daycraft — Personal Runlist: PRD edits & stakeholder follow-ups
content:
Date: 2026-03-12

Quick context: micro-day — focused on tightening the PRD before the ops sync on Friday. Keep this lean; todo items I can clear in 30–90m blocks.

MORNING SNAPSHOT
- Coffee. 20m inbox triage. Flagged 3 threads for async answers.
- Blocked: need final SLA language from legal (Maya). Email sent 09:18.
- Goals for today: finish PRD section (telemetry + acceptance), get sign-off from infra for rollout constraints, and confirm canary rollout window with SRE.

PRD EDITS (HIGHEST PRIORITY)
- Success metrics: rewrite to be measurable. Replace vague "improve latency" with: p50/p95 token-latency under 120ms/350ms respectively for 99% of requests in smoke region (us-west-2). Add measurement window and metric owner.
- Telemetry & observability: add required traces (request_id, model_variant, routing_policy) + an example log line. Note: ask console team if they can expose token-level cost in traces (linked ticket CONFLUENCE-UI-PRD-78).
- Acceptance criteria (doable in 1 week):
  - end-to-end smoke with sample prompt set (10 prompts) passing baseline quality checkpoint
  - perf regression <5% vs current model on p95
  - infra-approved scaling policy + canary config
- Rollout plan: change "2-week" to "2-stage: canary 24h -> stage 72h". Add rollback triggers (error rate >3% OR latency regression >20% for 15m).
- Docs to update after sign-off: API docs (samples), console route default settings, and internal changelog entry.

STUBS/NOTES TO SELF
- Insert small example: curl + streaming example + server-sent events section.
- Put a short bullet explaining model variant fallback behavior (when memory pressure triggers small-variant).
- Record known quirks: token-cost rounding differs by 0.2% between q4 and q8 quantized runs. Call out in "known risks".

STAKEHOLDER FOLLOW-UPS (ACTION ITEMS)
- Maya (Legal) — need SLA paragraph by EOD 2026-03-13. If she is delayed, default to the template in CONFLUENCE-UI-PRD-78 and mark as "pending legal".
- Riya (SRE) — confirm maintenance windows and canary IP allowlist. Pinged in slack (#sre-prod) 09:32. Goal: answer before infra sync.
- Tom (Console) — quick sync to ensure per-route telemetry is exposed in the console. Requested 30m slot tomorrow.
- Metrics (Liam) — can you add the 10-sample prompt set to the evaluation harness and run baseline? Commented on PR #512.

GO-LIVE PREFLIGHT (SHORT CHECKLIST)
- [ ] PRD final edits committed
- [ ] Legal SLA text inserted
- [ ] SRE confirms canary window + rollback steps
- [ ] Ops runbook skeleton added to confluence
- [ ] Smoke test script available and reviewed by QA
- [ ] Metrics job scheduled and baseline run completed
- [ ] Console display verification (token cost + latency)

TIMED TASKS (30/60/90m)
- 30m: finish the telemetry paragraph + example log line.
- 60m: edit acceptance criteria and rollout bullets. Push PR to docs repo.
- 90m: rapid sync with Liam + Maya (if available) and update PRD with legal blurb.

OPEN QUESTIONS / RISKS
- If we can't get token-cost in traces before rollout, do we ship with cost-estimates in a sidecar job? Pros/cons listed inline in PRD.
- Are we comfortable with 24h canary for a high-volume route? Need SRE opinion — note potential requirement to extend canary to 48h for volatile workloads.
- Does Dedicated tier require a separate telemetry path? Call out as "enterprise variant" in PRD.

RANDOM SCRATCH (for later grooming)
- Possible addition: small how-to for customers on "optimizing cost with cache + batching". Short 5-step.
- Capture anecdote: last week's smoke failed because sample prompts had long tail tokens; remove prompt #7 from baseline pool.

END-OF-DAY TICK (what to update after meetings)
- Update PRD with any wording change from legal.
- Annotate rollout plan with SRE feedback and escalate any extended canary needs.
- Add final links to the change log and PRs in the confluence page.

MINI-RETRO NOTES (personal)
- Keep edits tightly scoped in one commit. Avoid scope creep — two smaller iterations ship faster.
- When pinging stakeholders, include direct consequence: "if we don't get X by Y, we push to next window" (helps unblock fast).

END

(quick: will push the PRD draft after the 60m block and then loop in Liam + Maya for legal + metrics. If anything urgent: DM me.)
